text:
sam: heads-up — competitor launched per-tenant feature fallbacks + routing controls yesterday. receiving 2 enterprise asks to match parity for specific routes. thinking we should avoid a full parity copy; proposal: a tenant-scoped toggle that layers small differentiators on top of a parity baseline. @maya @jon can we scope effort and define launch gating?
maya: agree on toggle approach. engineering note: main cost is extra routing table + ability to pin model variant per-tenant. runtime impact ~+7% p99 tail from extra lookups if we do naive checks. we can mitigate with cached tenant-key in request header and a fast hash map.
jon: need to quantify cost tradeoffs: increased token cost (because some tenants hit larger model variant) vs infra cost. propose 2 phased variants: Variant P (parity baseline, same model we serve now) and Variant D (differentiator, slightly larger model / extra prompt layer). route by tenant flag.
tessa: from product/UX — we need clear GTM language: "Compatibility tier" for parity customers and "Differentiator add-on" for premium. important: marketing shouldn't imply feature parity for all endpoints, only per-route opt-in.
priya: sales — both AcmeCo and HomeSuite asked for exact per-route behavior. they're willing to pilot and sign an SLA addendum if we can do a 6–8 week pilot. they'll pay for early access.
maya: technical config example (draft):
```
feature_flags:
  tenant_overrides:
    - tenant_id: "acmeco"
      route_overrides:
        - route: "/generate-summary"
          variant: "D"
```
This keeps checks local to request parsing and caches the mapping.
jon: good. monitoring must include: per-tenant latency p50/p95/p99, per-tenant cost per 1k tokens, model-fallback rate. also synthetic prompt-set QA daily against both variants to catch regressions.
sam: proposed launch criteria (draft):
- Canary at 5% tenants for 2 days with no p99 degradation >10%
- Synthetic eval: no degradation in quality metrics >3% on core prompt set
- Per-tenant cost delta measured and approved by finance + sales pricing note
- Docs + SDK: example override config + migration path
- Legal sign-off for SLA addendum for pilot customers
If those pass, roll to paid tenants with gradual ramp.
release-bot: deploy scheduled: feature-flag scaffold to staging at 2025-06-05T10:00Z (CI#4729) :rocket:
jon: additions — include a toggle for auto-fallback (if Differentiator fails, fallback to Parity instantly) and a kill-switch global flag. synthetics should run nightly and send alerts to #eng-sre if quality delta > threshold.
tessa: design acceptance: UX controls in Console should show per-route overrides, tenant view, and cost estimate. need a mock for the console panel by EOD Thu.
priya: timeline ok from sales: pilot kickoff week of Jun 9. confirm owners and we'll queue contract.
sam: owners: maya = eng owner, jon = infra/monitoring, tessa = console/design, priya = sales pilot owner. I'll own product rollout playbook + OKR alignment. next steps: maya to PR a technical design doc by Tue, jon to scope monitoring playbook, tessa to push console mock, priya to secure pilot agreement. posting this as official thread for async updates — add quick replies here. :thumbsup:
